meta.name: red-team
meta.description: Adversarial security testing — think and attack like a criminal to expose vulnerabilities before real criminals do. Use when testing code, live services, or infrastructure for security weaknesses. Spawns parallel attack subagents targeting different surfaces.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 模拟攻击者手法，提前暴露安全弱点
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果在发布前想揪出能被黑客利用的安全漏洞
copy.tagline_en: Simulate real attacks to expose security weaknesses early
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want to find exploitable vulnerabilities before hackers do

howto.what: 装上后，Claude会扮演攻击者，对你的代码、网站或服务器做安全测试。它会先确认测试范围和边界，侦察目标，然后派出多个并行子代理从不同角度寻找漏洞，最后汇总成一份漏洞报告，并像事实一样告诉你哪里被打穿了。
howto.when: 当你要求测试代码、线上服务或基础设施的安全性，或说“红队测试”“渗透测试”等指令时触发。它会先跟你确认测试范围，再开始行动。

say.text: 对 https://example.com 做一次红队测试，先被动侦察。
say.note: 它会先确认范围，再启动侦察和攻击子代理。

say.text: 检查这个代码仓库有没有泄露的密钥。
say.note: 它会针对secrets攻击面展开检查。

say.text: 测试我们API的认证和输入校验，尝试越权。
say.note: 它会启动auth和injection攻击面子代理。

howto.what_en: After install, Claude acts as an attacker on your code, sites, or infrastructure. It confirms scope, does recon, spawns parallel subagents on different attack surfaces, and delivers a findings report stating exploits as facts.
howto.when_en: When you ask to test code, live services, or infrastructure for security weaknesses, or say 'red team' or 'penetration test'. It first confirms scope with you.

say_en.text: Run a red team test on https://example.com, passive recon only.
say_en.note: It confirms scope, then starts recon and attack subagents.

say_en.text: Check this code repo for leaked secrets.
say_en.note: It probes the secrets attack surface.

say_en.text: Test our API's auth and input validation for privilege escalation.
say_en.note: It spawns auth and injection surface subagents.
